goal: Run only explicitly supplied existing sentence-vector artifacts under an owned bounded local lifetime without building MFM, personality or an additional judgment model.
procedure: Freeze explicit artifact/configuration/package and CPU resource bounds; build the concrete standalone embedding launch plus exact independently qualified process manifest; preserve a fixed Python runtime prefix and explicit dependency directories because sealed executable descriptors do not preserve virtual-environment discovery; reauthorize current local reads before and after actual descriptor-relative bounded regular-file custody reads; transfer graph/tokenizer/text snapshots by bounded private pipe; install Linux address-space/CPU/open-file/file-size/core-file hard bounds before private decoding and native imports; load only an inline standard-op graph and serialized tokenizer without external tensors/functions/custom operators; use CPU sequential one-thread runtime settings; process deterministically contiguous chunks bounded by maximum_batch within one declared maximum_inputs/aggregate byte cap, one actual child/session and one overall deadline; reject overlong tokens or malformed vectors rather than truncate or invent pooling; bind exact request/artifact/configuration/input digests and bounded token records to vectors; reauthorize output acceptance; terminate and reap on failure/timeout/cancel; test with a tiny generated arithmetic graph and explicitly fictional independently signed qualification while leaving real suitability, rights and transitive qualification external.
authority: Procedure trace only. This builds local comparator execution infrastructure, grants no private read or external disclosure, certifies no embedding semantic quality or data rights and does not build or qualify any FloRA native model.
validation: Fifteen local lifecycle tests pass with optional onnx 1.17.0, onnxruntime 1.20.1, tokenizers 0.20.3 and numpy 2.2.6. A generated tiny arithmetic graph actually executes in a fresh child while parent ONNX session creation is forbidden. Tests cover current gate refusal before private input and after inference, exact artifact/qualification failure, descriptor confinement, input/output/token/memory bounds, one-child frozen chunking above perchunk cap, whole-call frozen wall clamp, queue deadline, retained passive-reader slot after cancellation and actual postspawn timeout/cancel child reaping. Production transitive/runtime artifact qualification, heldout retrieval quality and realistic latency remain unproven.
failure_or_lesson: Cancelling asyncio.to_thread cannot terminate an ONNX computation. A sealed Python executable loses its original install pathname and this environment failed to locate encodings under -I, so an exact explicit PYTHONHOME with -S -s -P and no inherited environment is required. Qualified package versions alone do not pin transitive native code. Perchunk batch bounds must coexist with a frozen total cap and one shared deadline; silently unlimited splitting would evade that contract. A general graph can depend on batch membership/padding, so the actual configured chunk rule needs artifact qualification.
notes: No model weights were downloaded, no real user data or API credentials were used, and no actual pretrained embedding quality or deployment latency is claimed. The generated graph/tokenizer and qualification are mechanical fixtures. Independent qualification must cover the real embedding artifact, actual Python standard library and explicit transitive dependency directories maintained immutable during invocation. The process is not an adversarial filesystem/network sandbox. Procedure seeds stay only in FloRA.
